findings.reason: a coordinator reading f-lamr-035 would dispatch §37 expecting a dated price on each row and could widen the node's scope or judge it incomplete, so the followup text must be corrected to match the section it points at.
findings.text: the followup f-lamr-035 (title at line 506, body at line 507) says the §37 row "carries that and its dated price", but §37's deliverable adds only `suits` and its Why explicitly declines rates ("A pick needs the relative standing, not exact prices: the lead asked ... that Jev be told which model is cheaper and which is stronger, rather than each model's published rates"); no step in §37 declares, reads or renders a price, so the followup promises a field the section does not build

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_candidate_state` (reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:236), `Candidate` (reckon/crew/picker/types.py:26), `option_key` (prompts.py:409), the merge at `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1106`, the `alias` slot (reckon/schema/flight.yaml:507) and `scripts/regen_flight_schema.py` all resolve; the glossary sentence in `reckon/crew/picker/templates/questions.jinja` exists.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §37's done-when is measurable (a declared flight, asserted row contents, `ruff` delta, base/head `representative_state_tokens` against the 2200 ceiling) and names a negative control of two mutations, each applied alone and each falsifiable against the declared scenario.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the done-when records gate figures (base and head `representative_state_tokens`) on the run's manifest, not a scratch path, and the granted test files live in `tests/`.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `suits` is a domain word rather than a plan label, and the new test path `tests/test_a_lane_model_says_what_it_suits.py` names the mechanism.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the section's mechanism is sound (verified: `suits` read from the merged `backend` mapping at snapshot.py:1106 is the same path `effort` is read on at snapshot.py:1247), but the plan's own followup f-lamr-035 promises a deliverable §37 does not specify.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §37 carries one deliverable, "add a declared statement of the work a model suits and render it on that model's row"; the schema, glossary and template edits are all that one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` carries `"s37": ["lane-and-model-routing#s36"]`, and no `informs`/`gates` meta names s37, so the section's only declared relationship is the one its "Once §36 lands" opening and its done-when (which runs §36's new test file) require.
